public.prepare_current_v2_protocol:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prepare_current_v2_protocol(p_source uuid, p_body jsonb, p_sha text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET jit TO 'off'
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
declare r public.historical_report_runs;q public.report_generation_requests;v uuid;begin
 if current_user<>'service_role' then raise exception 'FORBIDDEN';end if;
 select * into r from public.historical_report_runs where id=p_source;
 select * into q from public.report_generation_requests where source_run_id=r.id and engine='jev_sol_v2';
 if q.id is null or r.status not in('queued','running','retry') or r.created_at+interval '24 hours'<=now() or q.comparison_id is not null
 or not public.check_parallel_protocol(p_body) or public.jls_restaurant_hash(p_body)<>p_sha
 or p_body#>>'{current_delivery,request_id}'<>q.id::text or p_body#>>'{current_delivery,source_run_id}'<>r.id::text
 or p_body#>>'{reference,generation_id}'<>r.generation_id::text or p_body#>>'{reference,report_id}'<>r.id::text
 or p_body#>>'{reference,source_fingerprint}' is distinct from r.snapshot#>>'{base,source_fingerprint}'
 or p_body->'frozen_report' is distinct from ((r.snapshot->'base')||jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'generation_id',r.generation_id,'preferred_language',r.language,'ai_status','source_frozen','ai_model',null,'consultant_report',null))
 or jsonb_array_length(p_body#>'{source_snapshot,reviews}')<>jsonb_array_length(r.snapshot->'reviews')
 or (select count(distinct value->>'id') from jsonb_array_elements(p_body#>'{source_snapshot,reviews}'))<>jsonb_array_length(r.snapshot->'reviews') then raise exception 'CURRENT_V2_SOURCE_CHANGED';end if;
 if exists(with src as materialized(select value v from jsonb_array_elements(r.snapshot->'reviews')),dst as materialized(select value v from jsonb_array_elements(p_body#>'{source_snapshot,reviews}'))
 select 1 from dst left join src on src.v->>'id'=dst.v->>'id' where src.v is null
 or dst.v->>'original_text' is distinct from coalesce(src.v->>'original_text',src.v->>'text','')
 or dst.v->>'analysis_text' is distinct from nullif(src.v->>'analysis_text','') or dst.v->'rating' is distinct from src.v->'rating'
 or dst.v->'review_context' is distinct from src.v->'review_context' or dst.v->'review_detailed_rating' is distinct from src.v->'review_detailed_rating'
 or dst.v->'published_at' is distinct from src.v->'published_at' or dst.v->'analysis_source' is distinct from src.v->'analysis_source' or dst.v->'analysis_language' is distinct from src.v->'analysis_language'
 or dst.v->>'organization_id'<>q.organization_id::text or dst.v->>'establishment_id'<>q.establishment_id::text
 or dst.v->>'original_text_sha256' is distinct from encode(extensions.digest(dst.v->>'original_text','sha256'),'hex')
 or dst.v->>'analysis_text' is not null and dst.v->>'analysis_text_sha256' is distinct from encode(extensions.digest(dst.v->>'analysis_text','sha256'),'hex')) then raise exception 'CURRENT_V2_TEXT_CHANGED';end if;
 if exists(with src as materialized(select value v from jsonb_array_elements(p_body#>'{source_snapshot,reviews}')),tasks as materialized(select value v from jsonb_array_elements(p_body->'pending'))
 select 1 from tasks left join src on src.v->>'id'=tasks.v->>'review_id' where src.v->>'analysis_text' is null
 or tasks.v#>>'{payload,state,analysis_text}' is distinct from src.v->>'analysis_text' or tasks.v#>>'{payload,model}' is distinct from 'jev-1.13.0'
 or tasks.v#>'{payload,questions}' is distinct from p_body#>'{configuration,jev,questions}' or tasks.v->>'request_sha256' is distinct from public.jls_restaurant_hash(tasks.v->'payload')
 or tasks.v#>>'{identity,analysis_text_sha256}' is distinct from src.v->>'analysis_text_sha256' or tasks.v#>>'{identity,configuration_sha256}' is distinct from p_body->>'classification_configuration_sha256') then raise exception 'CURRENT_V2_REQUEST_CHANGED';end if;
 insert into public.analysis_parallel_launch_preparations(organization_id,authority_user_id,reference_generation_id,current_source_run_id,body,sha256) values(q.organization_id,q.authority_user_id,r.generation_id,r.id,p_body,p_sha)
 on conflict(current_source_run_id) do nothing returning id into v;
 if v is null then select id into v from public.analysis_parallel_launch_preparations where current_source_run_id=r.id and sha256=p_sha and body=p_body;end if;
 if v is null then raise exception 'CURRENT_V2_SEALED_PROTOCOL_CHANGED';end if;return v;
end $function$
public.guard_batch_frozen_data:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_batch_frozen_data()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if tg_table_name='analysis_jev_batch_tasks' then
  if (to_jsonb(new)-array['status','request_count','worker','lease_until','receipt','receipt_sha256','projection','projection_sha256','error_code','reserved_at','completed_at','input_tokens','output_tokens','duration_ms','served_model','provider_request_id'])
   is distinct from (to_jsonb(old)-array['status','request_count','worker','lease_until','receipt','receipt_sha256','projection','projection_sha256','error_code','reserved_at','completed_at','input_tokens','output_tokens','duration_ms','served_model','provider_request_id'])
   or new.request_count<old.request_count or old.receipt is not null and (new.receipt is distinct from old.receipt or new.receipt_sha256 is distinct from old.receipt_sha256
    or row(new.input_tokens,new.output_tokens,new.duration_ms,new.served_model,new.provider_request_id) is distinct from row(old.input_tokens,old.output_tokens,old.duration_ms,old.served_model,old.provider_request_id))
   or old.projection is not null and (new.projection is distinct from old.projection or new.projection_sha256 is distinct from old.projection_sha256)
   then raise exception 'BATCH_FROZEN_TASK_CHANGED';end if;
 else
  if new.snapshot is distinct from old.snapshot or new.snapshot_sha256 is distinct from old.snapshot_sha256 or new.template is distinct from old.template
   or new.manifest is distinct from old.manifest or new.manifest_sha256 is distinct from old.manifest_sha256 or new.source_manifest_sha256 is distinct from old.source_manifest_sha256
   or new.current_source_run_id is distinct from old.current_source_run_id or new.baseline_report_id is distinct from old.baseline_report_id or new.report_id<>old.report_id
   or new.organization_id<>old.organization_id or new.establishment_id<>old.establishment_id or new.configuration_version<>old.configuration_version
   or old.current_source_run_id is not null and row(new.max_new_jev_calls,new.expires_at,new.authorization_evidence) is distinct from row(old.max_new_jev_calls,old.expires_at,old.authorization_evidence)
   or new.sol_request_count<old.sol_request_count or old.envelope is not null and (new.envelope is distinct from old.envelope or new.envelope_sha256 is distinct from old.envelope_sha256)
   or old.sol_receipt is not null and (new.sol_receipt is distinct from old.sol_receipt or new.sol_receipt_sha256 is distinct from old.sol_receipt_sha256)
   then raise exception 'BATCH_FROZEN_RUN_CHANGED';end if;
 end if;return new;
end $function$
public.jev_batch_refresh_usage:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jev_batch_refresh_usage(p_run uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r public.analysis_jev_batch_runs;j jsonb;begin
 select * into r from public.analysis_jev_batch_runs where id=p_run;
 select jsonb_build_object('new_provider_attempts',coalesce(sum(request_count),0),'reused_batches',count(*) filter(where historical_source is not null),
  'new_usage',jsonb_build_object('provider_attempts',coalesce(sum(request_count),0),'input_tokens',sum(input_tokens) filter(where request_count=1),
   'output_tokens',sum(output_tokens) filter(where request_count=1),'summed_provider_duration_ms',sum(duration_ms) filter(where request_count=1),
   'usage_complete',count(*) filter(where request_count=1 and (input_tokens is null or output_tokens is null))=0),
  'historical',coalesce(sum(request_count),0)=0) into j from public.analysis_jev_batch_tasks where run_id=p_run;
 update public.analysis_parallel_reports set usage=coalesce(usage,'{}')||jsonb_build_object('jev',j,'luna_calls',0,'apify_calls',0) where id=r.report_id;
 if r.current_source_run_id is not null then
  update public.historical_report_runs set ai_calls=(j->>'new_provider_attempts')::int,input_tokens=coalesce((j#>>'{new_usage,input_tokens}')::bigint,0),output_tokens=coalesce((j#>>'{new_usage,output_tokens}')::bigint,0),token_usage_complete=(j#>>'{new_usage,usage_complete}')::boolean,updated_at=now() where id=r.current_source_run_id;
 end if;
end $function$
